rpmsg.config:
#conf file sample
#locate conf file to under /etc/

#mode [ daemon / debug ]
mode=daemon
#log level [ EMERG<ALERT<CRIT<ERROR(default)<WARN<NOTICE<INFO<DEBUG ]
loglevel=DEBUG
#output [ file / console / none ]
#logfile path is "/var/log/rpmsg-daemon.log"
output=file
#open device path
devname=/dev/rpmsg_ctrl0
#src address

#dst address
